component.name: Keyhop
component.summary: Switch AI coding accounts and track their usage

description.p: Keyhop keeps several Claude Code, Cursor and Codex accounts on one computer and moves a tool to another account in one click, so you can keep working when one account's limit runs out.
It reads each account's limits with that account's own login, tracks tokens and their value at API prices from the tools' local logs, and warns before a limit or budget runs out.
